scope: GAP-INGEST-005 numeric date conventions. An unambiguous numeric date (day or month above 12) resolves independently, and an ambiguous numeric date stays unresolved with both interpretations preserved; one field’s date order is never propagated to another field, and no explicit date-format label mechanism exists in accepted policy, so a decisive ambiguous date is always withheld rather than resolved by unrelated evidence. Implementation is closed by be-gap-ingest-005 + aj-ingest-dates + z-general-intake; staging verification is pending.
